text: {"lessons":["I’ll avoid adding to a stock just because it has risen; I’ll check whether its prospects still justify the price and keep position sizes disciplined.","I won’t sell solely to avoid admitting a loss or hold solely to wait for breakeven; I’ll base each decision on the outlook and risk from today onward.","One month’s account gain or loss is not enough to judge a trade, so I’ll review my decisions over longer periods and compare returns with the overall market."]}
